title: Extractable Evidence Packet
description: Schema for a structured, source-backed input prepared for a future AI extraction job. An evidence packet binds a reviewed snapshot (via its review manifest) to bounded evidence references — locators, excerpt references, and optional content fingerprints — not large copied source text. No scraping, no network, no AI provider calls, and no full source content ingestion happen in this layer. An evidence packet may be AI-ready, but it is never classifier-approved or downstream-safe by virtue of being extractable.

evidence_packet_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence packet.

review_manifest_id.description: Identifier of the review manifest that gates this packet. An evidence packet without its review manifest is not a controlled input.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of the source snapshot this packet is derived from.

source_id.description: Identifier of the registered source the snapshot belongs to.

evidence_scope.description: What this packet scopes the evidence to (e.g. hs_chapter_headings, ncm_aec_rates). Describes intent, not a regulatory conclusion.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Optional jurisdiction scope label for the evidence (e.g. international, mercosur, ar).

language.description: Optional primary language of the referenced source material (e.g. en, es).

content_reference.description: Optional bounded local/manual reference to the captured material. Not raw ingested content. Placeholder references must be labelled manual/local/requires-verification.

excerpt_reference.description: Optional bounded reference to a specific excerpt/location (e.g. section/page anchor), never large copied source text.

content_fingerprint.description: Optional content fingerprint in sha256 format (with optional 'sha256:' prefix). Only present when genuinely tied to captured content.

extraction_input_type.description: The kind of input this packet provides to a future extraction job.

extraction_allowed.description: Whether AI extraction may consume this packet. Only true where the governing review manifest supports it and a usable content/excerpt/fingerprint reference exists. Defaults to false.

extraction_status.description: AI extraction preparation state for this packet. No provider integration exists in this layer.

human_review_required.description: Must be true for any packet that may back classification/compliance intelligence. Defaults to true.

downstream_allowed.description: Whether downstream classifier use is approved. An evidence packet must not approve downstream use on its own; defaults to false.

classifier_approval_reference.description: Optional reference to a separate classifier-approval record. Required before downstream_allowed may be true, which this evidence layer does not itself grant.

warnings.description: Optional warnings raised during evidence preparation (e.g. a missing fingerprint).

limitations.description: Optional known limitations of this packet (e.g. content not ingested, no regulatory claim made).

evidence_refs.description: Array of evidence references used by the extraction agent to build context.

metadata.description: Optional extra metadata for local traceability.

created_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when the packet record was created.

contract_version.description: Optional semantic version of the evidence packet contract this record follows.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this evidence packet payload.

allOf.description: An extractable packet must be traceable to bounded evidence: at least one of a content reference, excerpt reference, or content fingerprint. Extraction readiness without any reference is not allowed.
An evidence packet must not approve downstream classifier use on its own. Downstream use requires a separate classifier approval reference; this packet is AI-ready, not downstream-approved.
